invariants.I1: Each physical detector invocation has a unique source_batch_id or the versioned repository contract explicitly adopts and joins a distinct invocation ID.
invariants.I2: Each fused correction has exactly one truthful terminal assimilation outcome.
invariants.I3: State, covariance, frame and timestamp describe one instant and epoch.
invariants.I4: Only the authorized serialized transaction modifies recursive state.
invariants.I5: Belief publication and planning use immutable snapshots and reject stale work at commit.
invariants.I6: Command ownership and stop precedence are unambiguous through physical application.
invariants.I7: Planner, tracker, adapter and actuator limits share one validated resolved source.
invariants.I8: Capture, arrival, decision, commit, belief and command times remain distinguishable.
invariants.I9: Missing camera evidence and missing motion support have distinct states and reasons.
invariants.I10: Contact, command receipt, command application, physical rest and terminal mission status remain distinct and joined.
invariants.I11: Manifest binds exact imported source, resolved config, model, calibration, world, robot, route and attempt.
invariants.I12: Logger drains terminal events, survives individual write/close failures and supports reconstruction.
invariants.I13: Offline validation accepts or refuses the run for explicit contract reasons before reference scoring.
invariants.I14: README, HOW_IT_WORKS, runtime audit, registry, protocol and captions describe the repaired active path and evidence boundary.

rule: Every scenario is evaluated against I1-I14. An unexercised channel is NOT VERIFIED, never PASS.
